{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing or sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0]).sum())

# Check the overall distribution
print("Mean baseline biomarker value (before filtering sentinels):", df['biomarker_baseline'].mean())

# Filter out sentinel values (-999.0) as they likely indicate missing or invalid data
valid_baseline = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean of valid values
mean_baseline = valid_baseline.mean()

# Print the result
mean_baseline"}
